battle.name: 巴什穆爾叛亂
battle.brief: 720年色雷斯巴什穆爾人起兵反叛羅姆帝國，敘利亞方面的哈里發勢力以金錢軍械暗中支援，叛軍聯合北方保加爾騎兵與阿巴吉亞、斯拉夫人。皇帝利奧三世自君士坦丁堡北伐，於阿馬塞納河慘敗負傷被俘，翌年再於馬塞拉取勝。圖示羅馬重步兵即主題區重裝步兵，以大盾長矛的線列擋住叛軍正面衝鋒。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 交戰一方是羅姆帝國，即後世所稱的拜占庭，720 年在位的皇帝是伊索里安王朝的利奧三世，首都君士坦丁堡。帝國此時已用主題區（themata）制度劃分軍區，與本役關係最密切的是歐普西基翁（Opsikion，控扼色雷斯與都城北面的大營）與色雷斯區（Thracesiai），野戰主力由 comitatenses 常備軍與首都 tagmata 戒嚴兵團構成，並雜有瓦蘭吉亞人與保加爾人的奴隸兵、傭兵，以及亞美尼亞盟軍。舊式帝國軍團（legiones）編制在四世紀末已廢除，帝國的重裝步兵改由主題區與常備軍的步兵承擔，卡面「羅馬重步兵」正是這個兵種血脈的符號。另一方是巴什穆爾—保加爾聯軍：色雷斯的巴什穆爾人（Bashmurs，日耳曼—哥特系的 foederati，定居在羅赫卑山脈與斯特魯蒙河流域，受帝國庇蔭而承擔邊防與兵役），聯合多瑙河下游至伏爾加上游的保加爾人，編年史所記的叛軍首領出自這一系，麾下並有阿巴吉亞人與斯拉夫部眾，騎兵是其骨幹。第三方是阿拉伯方面：720 年仍是倭馬亞哈里發國（歐麥爾二世在位，翌年改由希沙姆執政），據編年史記載，敘利亞與亞美尼亞方向的阿拉伯當局以金錢和武器資助叛軍，用意是把帝國的注意力釘在色雷斯，以配合阿拉伯—拜占庭的邊境戰爭；而在帝國一方的聯軍裡，同樣出現了多瑙河北岸的斯拉夫人與保加爾人。整體而言，這是一場邊區盟邦、北方部眾與外部強權三方糾纏的地方性叛亂。
countriesEn: One side was the Roman Empire, the state later called Byzantium, ruled in 720 by the Isaurian emperor Leo III with Constantinople as capital. The empire now organized its army by themata, the thematic districts, and those most closely involved here were the Opsikion, which held Thrace and the great camp north of the capital, and the Thracesiai. The field army was made up of comitatenses, the permanent mobile troops, together with the tagmata garrison of the capital, and was mixed with Varangian and Bulgar slaves and mercenaries and with Armenian allies. The old imperial legions had been abolished at the end of the fourth century, so the heavy infantry of the empire was now carried by the thematic and comitatensis foot; the card's Roman heavy infantry is precisely the symbol of that line of descent. The other side was a Bashmur-Bulgar coalition. The Bashmurs of Thrace were a Germanic, Gothic-descended foederati people settled in the Rhodope mountains and the valley of the Strymon, sheltered by the empire and enrolled in its frontier service. They were joined by Bulgars from the lower Danube and the upper Volga, the rebel chief recorded by the chronicler belonging to that very lineage, with Abasgians and Slavs also serving under him, and cavalry was the arm of the rebel host. A third party was the Arabs: in 720 the caliphate was still Umayyad, with Umar II on the throne and Hisham succeeding him the following year. The chronicle states that the Arab authorities in the Syrian and Armenian direction supplied the rebels with money and weapons, the point being to pin the empire's attention in Thrace and to fit into the Arab-Byzantine frontier war. Slavs and Bulgars from the far bank of the Danube also appear, this time on the imperial side of the field. Altogether this was a regional revolt in which a frontier client people, northern tribes and an outside great power all pulled at one another.
people: 核心人物是皇帝利奧三世（Leo III the Isaurian，約 675 至 741），伊索里安王朝第二位君主，在 717 至 718 年阿拉伯大軍圍困君士坦丁堡的危機中於 718 年即位，720 年以共同皇帝身分親率大軍出戰色雷斯。他在阿馬塞納河戰敗時受傷，撤退途中被叛軍包圍於阿德里安堡，退入菲利波波利斯後被俘，囚於保加爾翁一類的堡壘；據記載他趁夜色經水道或暗道脫身、涉水渡河而歸，一年後再率聯軍取勝。他之兄米海爾一世當時仍是長兄皇帝，坐鎮君士坦丁堡，直到 813 年才退位為修士，本役中並未親征，編年史把守城與募兵之事記在都城一端。叛軍首領在編年史中多以巴什穆爾人的君主出現，後世學者常以「庫貝爾（Kuber 或 Kubrat）」稱之，並把他與伏爾加保加爾國的建立者聯繫起來，但把兩者直接等同的做法至今仍是爭議，主流看法認為編年史在此把巴什穆爾人與保加爾人混用。除皇帝與叛首外，編年史還提到色雷斯區與歐普西基翁的軍事指揮官（katepano）、色雷斯的守將與地方長老，以及前來援助的亞美尼亞人；阿拉伯方面出手相助的具體人物在史料中沒有留下名字。本役最重要的史料是拜占庭編年史家狄奧菲內斯（Theophanes the Confessor，約 750 至 818）的《年代記》，其敘述幾乎構成我們對 720 至 721 年戰事唯一的細節來源，Zonaras 與 811 年的匿名編年史則有簡略補充。
peopleEn: The central figure is the emperor Leo III the Isaurian, roughly 675 to 741, the second monarch of the Isaurian dynasty, crowned in 718 during the crisis of the great Arab siege of Constantinople, who in 720 personally led the field army into Thrace while still co-emperor. He was wounded at the Amasena, was surrounded by the rebels at Adrianople during his retreat, was captured after withdrawing to Philippopolis, and was held in a fortress of the Bulgarion kind; the chronicle has him escape in the dark by a hidden watercourse or passage and wade across a river to reach the imperial side, and a year later return with a coalition host to win. His brother Michael I was at that moment still the senior emperor sitting in Constantinople and did not campaign in person, abdicating only in 813 to become a monk, and the chronicler places the guarding of the city and the recruiting of troops in the capital throughout the emergency. The rebel chief appears in the chronicle as a prince of the Bashmurs; later scholars commonly name him Kuber or Kubrat and connect him with the founder of the Volga Bulgar state, but this identification has never been settled, and the mainstream view holds that the chronicle uses Bashmur and Bulgar interchangeably at this point. Besides the emperor and the rebel leader, the chronicle names the military commanders of the Thracesiai and the Opsikion, the Thracian garrison commanders and local notables, and mentions Armenians who came to the empire's aid; the Arab who supplied the money and the arms is left without a name. The principal source for the entire episode is the Chronicle of Theophanes the Confessor, composed around 750 to 818, whose narrative is very nearly the only detailed account of the fighting of 720 and 721, with Zonaras and the anonymous chronicle of 811 adding brief touches.
kits: 卡面的「羅馬重步兵」是古典軍團步兵的類型符號：方形大盾（scutum）、鎖子甲或鱗甲、胸甲、雙手直刀與短投槍。然而 720 年的羅姆帝國在編制上早已不用舊式軍團，這一形象在實戰中的對應物，是從軍團步兵一脈演變而來的主題區重裝步兵，即 scutarii 與 paramerion 一類以大盾立於陣前的盾兵，以及各鎮的 comitatenses 常備步兵；他們的裝備沿用帝國傳統：橢圓大盾（thureos）與圓盾、長矛（pilum 這類短投槍此時已讓位給更長的矛柄兵器）、胸甲、鎖子甲與頭盔，近衛與貴族部隊另用雲形盾（skouton）。騎兵方面最重裝的一支是鎧甲重騎（kataphractoi 與 klivanophoroi），配馬鎧、長槍（kontos）與直刀；數量更多的輕騎與弓箭手（toxotai）負責偵察、追擊與遮蔽，北方傭兵幾乎全屬這一類。攻城與野戰器材方面，圍攻要塞依靠壕溝、柴柵、填土與臨時架設的攻城塔，並以撞錘與火攻焚燒城門；對雙方而言，堡壘就是決定戰役的節點，阿德里安堡與保加爾翁的存亡直接左右了 720 年那一年的走向。帝軍後勤靠 via Egnatia 的陸路與海運供應，冬季的色雷斯多雨泥濘，一旦輜重線被叛軍騎兵切斷，前線部隊就必須退回堡壘固守。
kitsEn: The Roman heavy infantry on the card is a type symbol of the classical legionary: the large rectangular scutum, mail or scale armor, a breastplate, a two-handed straight sword and the short throwing pilum. Yet the Roman empire of 720 no longer used the old legions in its organization, and the counterpart of that image on the field was the thematic heavy infantry descended in direct line from the legionary, that is the scutarii and paramerion, shield-bearers who stood in front of the line with their large shields, together with the comitatensis foot of the individual districts. Their equipment followed imperial tradition: the large oval thureos and round shields, long spears, since the short pilum had by then given way to longer-hafted arms, breastplates, mail and helmets, while the guard and the nobility carried the curved skouton. On the cavalry side the most heavily armoured were the klivanophoroi, the armoured lancers, with horse and rider in mail, a long kontos and a straight sword; the far more numerous light horse and the archers, the toxotai, handled scouting, pursuit and screening, and the northern mercenaries were almost entirely of this kind. For siege and field works the reduction of a fortress relied on ditches, wooden fences, filled earth and hastily raised siege towers, with rams and fire used against the gates; for both sides the fortress was the hinge of the campaign, and the fate of Adrianople and of the Bulgarion determined the whole turn of the year 720. Imperial logistics ran on the land route of the Via Egnatia and on sea transport, and the wet muddy winters of Thrace meant that once the baggage train was cut by rebel cavalry the forward troops had to fall back and hold their castles.
tactics: 叛軍的戰法以騎兵游擊與伏擊為主。巴什穆爾人熟悉色雷斯的森林、山地與村落，刻意避免在開闊地與帝軍主力正面會戰，改為襲擊行軍縱隊、切割警戒線，攻擊營帳與輜重，必要時再圍困帝軍依託的要塞。720 年 6 月 24 日，帝軍在阿馬塞納河一帶的林地峽道被突襲，陣形尚在展開、前鋒與本隊脫節，利奧的營帳被攻破，他本人在騎兵掩護下突圍，損失慘重；此後帝軍一路退向阿德里安堡，又退到菲利波波利斯而被包圍俘獲。721 年的進攻則改為主動列陣：帝軍在馬塞拉附近以步兵盾牆正面承受叛軍衝鋒，長矛線抵住密集的騎兵衝撞，己方騎兵在兩翼待機，待對方攻勢衰竭、陣形浮動時再以縱隊反擊並掩殺追擊，叛軍由此崩潰，首腦陣亡。兩役的分野在於能否掌握戰場主動權：第一次帝軍行軍序列拉得太長而遭突襲，第二次則先以步兵線固定陣腳，再讓騎兵決定勝負；整整一年的準備（720 年 6 月敗、721 年 7 月勝）之中，編年史還提到色雷斯的地震與鼠疫拖慢了部隊的調集。
tacticsEn: The rebels fought as mounted harassment and ambush. The Bashmurs knew the forests, hills and villages of Thrace and deliberately avoided meeting the imperial main force in the open, preferring instead to fall on the marching column, to cut the picket line, to strike at the command tent and the baggage, and when necessary to besiege the fortresses the imperial army relied on. On 24 June 720 the imperial army was ambushed in a wooded defile near the Amasena, its order still forming, the vanguard detached from the main body; Leo's tent was carried and he broke out under cover of horse, taking severe losses. The army then withdrew to Adrianople and on to Philippopolis, where it was surrounded and captured. The campaign of 721 was fought the other way round, as a deliberate battle line: near Marcellae the imperial infantry held a wall of shields against the charge, the spear line stopped the massed impact of the rebel horse, and the imperial cavalry waited on both flanks to counterattack in column once the enemy's attack had spent itself and its formation had shaken, and to sweep up the fugitives; the rebels broke and their chief was killed. The dividing line between the two years was the mastery of the initiative. In the first the imperial column was stretched too far and was ambushed; in the second the infantry line fixed the battle and the cavalry decided it. Through the whole year of preparation, from the defeat of June 720 to the victory of July 721, the chronicle also notes that an earthquake and plague in Thrace slowed the gathering of troops.
data: 可核對的數字主要來自編年史的日期與相對規模。叛軍發動與帝軍首次交戰落在 720 年 6 月 24 日，阿馬塞納河之敗即在此日；帝軍反攻取決於 721 年 7 月 22 日的馬塞拉之戰，兩役相隔約一年，正好橫跨一個冬季與一次大規模徵募。編年史稱叛軍首領麾下有上萬騎兵，並有大量步兵與阿巴吉亞、斯拉夫部眾參與；利奧在 721 年集結的聯軍則以數萬計，另徵召多瑙河北岸的斯拉夫人與保加爾人，其具體數字在不同抄本中互相矛盾，學者多視為夸飾，故此處只作量級引用。就地理而言，自君士坦丁堡至阿德里安堡約二百公里，至菲利波波利斯約五百公里，帝軍沿陸路進軍並靠海運補給；背景中的阿拉伯圍城軍（717 至 718 年）以萬計，最終其艦隊於 718 年在博斯普魯斯海峽被摧毀而解了都城之圍。傷亡方面沒有可靠數字，流傳說法多為編年史的修辭，本卡只記可核實的結果：720 年的失敗使帝軍損失大批裝備與輜重，連皇帝本人負傷被俘；721 年勝後叛軍潰散，首腦被殺，餘部向北方退回。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked come mainly from the dates and the relative scale preserved by the chronicle. The rising and the first clash between the rebel and imperial armies fall on 24 June 720, the day of the defeat at the Amasena; the counterstroke depended on the battle of Marcellae on 22 July 721, the two standing roughly a year apart, spanning one winter and one great levy. The chronicle says the rebel chief had more than ten thousand horsemen under him, with masses of foot and Abasgians and Slavs taking part; the coalition Leo gathered in 721 ran to tens of thousands, and he called in Slavs and Bulgars from the far bank of the Danube, though the exact numbers conflict between manuscripts and are generally treated by scholars as exaggeration, so they are cited here only as orders of magnitude. Geographically the march ran some two hundred kilometres from Constantinople to Adrianople and about five hundred to Philippopolis, the imperial army advancing by land and resupplied by sea. The Arab besieging army of the background years, 717 to 718, numbered in the tens of thousands and was finally broken when its fleet was destroyed in the Bosporus in 718, relieving the capital. No reliable casualty figures survive; the numbers that circulate are largely the rhetoric of the chronicle, so only the checkable results are set down here: the defeat of 720 cost the imperial army large quantities of equipment and baggage and took the emperor himself wounded and captive; after the victory of 721 the rebels dissolved, their chief was killed, and the survivors withdrew northward.
cause: 直接起因是巴什穆爾人與羅姆中央之間累積的邊區矛盾。這批日耳曼—哥特系部眾早年是帝國的 foederati，定居色雷斯後被編入邊防體系，替帝國守住多瑙河與色雷斯的通道；然而盟邦條款要求他們提供兵役與守備，帝國一方卻以徵稅、土地收授與官員的司法介入逐步侵蝕這些權利，720 年爆發的就是這種全面翻臉，編年史形容它不是部分人的騷動，而是全族起事，其首領聲稱要恢復舊有的自由與地盤。外部因素同樣關鍵：717 至 718 年阿拉伯對君士坦丁堡的圍城雖告失敗，但哈里發國家與北方部眾聯手、在拜占庭背後製造動亂的戰略已經成形，編年史明言敘利亞與亞美尼亞方向的阿拉伯當局以金錢和武器資助叛軍。內部方面，帝國剛從阿拉伯人的長期圍城中脫身，首都與邊區的注意力、稅收與人力都被抽調去對付阿拉伯，人心浮動；719 至 720 年地中海世界正在經歷第三次鼠疫大流行，色雷斯又有地震，邊軍的士氣與守備都受到削弱。三者交疊，衝突便在阿拉伯新攻勢尚未到來之前，先於色雷斯內陸爆發。
causeEn: The immediate cause was a long accumulation of friction between the Bashmurs and the Roman centre. This Germanic and Gothic-descended people had been foederati of the empire; once settled in Thrace they were enrolled in the frontier system and held the Danube and the Thracian passes for Rome. The terms of the client arrangement obliged them to furnish troops and garrison duty, while on the Roman side taxation, the assignment of land and the judicial intervention of officials steadily eroded those rights, and what broke out in 720 was a complete rupture of that kind. The chronicle describes it not as the riot of a faction but as a rising of the whole people, with the chief claiming to restore the old freedom and lands. The external factor mattered just as much: although the Arab siege of Constantinople in 717 and 718 had failed, the strategy of the caliphate and the northern tribes acting together to stir trouble in the empire's rear was already formed, and the chronicle states plainly that the Arab authorities in the Syrian and Armenian direction supplied the rebels with money and arms. Internally, the empire had only just come out of the long Arab siege; the attention, the taxes and the manpower of the capital and the frontier were all drawn off to face the Arabs, and the mood was unsettled. Between 719 and 720 the Mediterranean world was in the grip of the third plague pandemic, and Thrace was shaken by earthquake, so the morale and readiness of the frontier troops suffered. Overlapping, these three pressures made the conflict break out in the interior of Thrace before the Arabs' new offensive could arrive.
impact: 對羅姆帝國而言，這場叛亂的結果是保住而不是喪失：色雷斯的邊防沒有崩潰，首都通往多瑙河的補給線得以延續，伊索里安王朝也沒有像八世紀後半那樣被軍人政變掀翻。從更長的視角看，720 至 721 年確立了阿拉伯與拜占庭角力在巴爾幹長期化的格局：編年史此後不斷在「巴什穆爾人」與「保加爾人」之間混用同一批叛軍，而八世紀多次從多瑙河下游南下的騎兵劫掠（763 至 764 年的戰役、780 年前後的色雷斯戰事）都以這次平叛為起點，北方部眾也從此在拜占庭文獻中同時扮演盟友與入侵者兩種角色。另一個長期的影響在身份辨識上：巴什穆爾人究竟只是色雷斯的哥特系土著，還是已經南下的伏爾加保加爾人（Kubrat 系）？這個問題至今沒有定論，但它直接影響學者如何理解 7 世紀末 8 世紀初「保加爾人」這個名號的內涵。軍制層面上，野戰軍、首都戒嚴兵團與邊防軍的搭配，以及盟邦體系與省區體系之間的重新平衡，都在這場危機的背景下被推動，741 年阿爾塔巴多斯的軍事政變顯示軍隊的不滿並未因此消除。對本卡的兵器符號而言，這一役也說明：羅馬重步兵的傳統到 720 年已轉化為主題區的盾兵，而非帝制時期的方盾軍團。
impactEn: For the Roman empire the result of this rising was a thing preserved rather than a thing lost: the Thracian frontier did not collapse, the supply line from the capital to the Danube was kept open, and the Isaurian dynasty was not overturned by a military usurpation as it would be in the later eighth century. From a longer view, 720 and 721 established the long duration of the Arab-Byzantine contest in the Balkans. The chronicle thereafter keeps using Bashmur and Bulgar interchangeably for the same rebels, and the repeated raids by horse coming south from the lower Danube in the eighth century, the war of 763 to 764 and the Thracian fighting around 780, all take their starting point from this pacification, while the northern tribes henceforward play both the role of ally and the role of invader in Byzantine literature. A second long-term effect lies in the question of identity: were the Bashmurs simply the Gothic natives of Thrace, or already the Volga Bulgars of Kubrat's line moving south? That has never been settled, but it bears directly on how the term Bulgar is understood in the late seventh and early eighth centuries. At the level of military organization, the pairing of field army, capital garrison and frontier troops, and the rebalancing between the client system and the provincial system, were all advanced against the background of this crisis, and the military coup of Artabasdos in 741 shows that the army's grievances were not thereby removed. For the weapon symbol on this card, the episode also shows that the tradition of the Roman heavy infantry had by 720 been transformed into the themed shield-bearer rather than the square-shielded legionary of the early empire.
result: 720 年的過程是一場徹底的失敗：帝軍在阿馬塞納河遭突襲，利奧三世負傷，撤退時被叛軍追擊圍困於阿德里安堡，再退往菲利波波利斯而被俘，囚於保加爾翁一類的堡壘，靠夜色中的涉水脫逃才回到帝國一側，首都幾乎在無主的情況下度過了一個冬天。一年後形勢完全逆轉：利奧重新集結主力與斯拉夫、保加爾盟軍，自北方再度進入色雷斯，於 721 年 7 月 22 日在馬塞拉列陣迎戰，步兵線正面抵住叛軍的密集衝鋒，騎兵在兩翼待機反擊，叛軍崩潰，首腦在追擊中被殺（傳說其首級被送回君士坦丁堡），餘眾向多瑙河方向散去；利奧凱旋返回都城，在聖索菲亞大教堂獻上感恩。叛亂至此平定，色雷斯的秩序恢復，但這並非終局：保加爾人仍盤據多瑙河北岸，帝國的巴爾干邊界從此進入長期戰爭的狀態，而 720 年留下的裂痕，包括軍隊對薪酬與晉升的不滿，在二十年後的 741 年再度爆發。
resultEn: The course of 720 was a total failure. The imperial army was ambushed at the Amasena, Leo III was wounded, and on the retreat he was chased by the rebels, surrounded at Adrianople, and captured after withdrawing to Philippopolis, where he was held in a fortress of the Bulgarion kind and only regained the imperial side by wading across a river in the dark. The capital spent a winter very nearly without its emperor. A year later the situation was completely reversed: Leo gathered the main force afresh together with Slavic and Bulgar allies, entered Thrace again from the north, and on 22 July 721 offered battle at Marcellae, where the infantry line took the shock of the rebel massed charge head on while the cavalry waited on the flanks to counterattack. The rebels broke, their chief was killed in the pursuit, the tale going that his head was carried back to Constantinople, and the survivors scattered toward the Danube. Leo returned to the capital in triumph and gave thanks in the church of St Sophia. The rising was over and order in Thrace was restored, but this was not the end of the matter. The Bulgars still held the far bank of the Danube, the Balkan frontier of the empire entered on a long season of war, and the cracks opened in 720, including the army's dissatisfaction over pay and promotion, broke out again in 741.
